traceway-1.2.1.js is @tracewayapp/frontend 1.2.1, dist/traceway.iife.global.js, copied unmodified from the
npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tracewayapp/frontend

@tracewayapp/frontend is released under the MIT License, as its README states. Neither the npm package nor its
source repository (https://github.com/tracewayapp/js-client, checked on 2026-10-11) ships a licence file or a
copyright line to reproduce here.

The build bundles rrweb (https://github.com/rrweb-io/rrweb), whose licence follows. It also carries a notice
for the Microsoft tslib helpers that rrweb bundles; that notice is kept, as published, at the end of
traceway-1.2.1.js itself.
